title: Gate values for valid straight-line lines
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ss$ be a list of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs in which each statement reads only input variables, their negations, or earlier lines, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to the inputs. For every $j<|ss|$, the value at vertex $2n+j$ in the gate list for $ss$ equals the value at position $j$ in the execution of $ss$ on $x$, with an out-of-range list position interpreted as false.
hypotheses_covered: Every statement at position $i$ reads only lines with index less than $i$
